floor_stratum.variable: headroom_screen.json -- R2ACTION piloting each team at n=150
floor_stratum.why_not_the_parent_wr: Stratifying on an arm's OWN measured WR and then differencing that same arm induces regression to the mean. The screen is an independent measurement of a third model, so it cannot.

R2PLAIN.role: PLAIN training, no teacher of any kind

R2CTRL.role: teachers in the ECOLOGY, distill coef 0

replicate_pair_audit.verdict: R2CTRL == R2PLAIN in effective configuration ⇒ REPLICATE PAIR of plain training
